summary_1line: Krishna explains the fiery energy from his penance, invites sages to share wonders, and Narada begins a tale of Shiva’s third eye arising when Uma covers his eyes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Uma playfully covers Shiva’s eyes from behind on a Himalayan peak, and the entire universe falls suddenly into darkness.
A blazing third eye bursts open on Shiva’s forehead, sending a pillar of fire that consumes the forests and peaks of the Himalayas.
Frightened deer and animals flee the burning mountain and gather around the seated Shiva seeking refuge.
